toolsMacBench.entryScript: tools/mac-bench/run-mac-bench.sh — single command; macOS-guarded (uname != Darwin → precise refusal, exit 3, verified on this Linux host); builds Swift extractor (swift build -c release), cold pass → pnpm lab:regen --exec → N warm passes → pnpm lab:cascade → assembles mac-bench-results-v1 JSON

toolsMacBench.comparison: tools/mac-bench/src/compareResults.ts — mac-bench-compare-v1; verdicts OK/REGRESSION/NOT_COMPARABLE; cascade drops & silent-failure rises are regressions; contract re-versions are NOT_COMPARABLE; latency regression gates: >10% AND >50ms on P50/P95; nonzero exit for CI gating
